entries.title: Job 26:2
segments: "How have you helped [him who is] without power? [How] have you saved the arm [that has] no strength?

entries.title: Job 26:3
segments: How have you counseled [one who has] no wisdom? And [how] have you declared sound advice to many?

entries.title: Job 26:4
segments: To whom have you uttered words? And whose spirit came from you?

entries.title: Job 26:5
segments: ¶"The dead tremble, Those under the waters and those inhabiting them.

entries.title: Job 26:6
segments: Sheol [is] naked before Him, And Destruction has no covering.

entries.title: Job 26:7
segments: He stretches out the north over empty space; [He] hangs the earth on nothing.

entries.title: Job 26:8
segments: He binds up the water in His thick clouds, Yet the clouds are not broken under it.

entries.title: Job 26:9
segments: He covers the face of [His] throne, [And] spreads His cloud over it.

entries.title: Job 26:10
segments: He drew a circular horizon on the face of the waters, At the boundary of light and darkness.

entries.title: Job 26:11
segments: The pillars of heaven tremble, And are astonished at His rebuke.

entries.title: Job 26:12
segments: He stirs up the sea with His power, And by His understanding He breaks up the storm.

entries.title: Job 26:13
segments: By His Spirit He adorned the heavens; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

entries.title: Job 26:14
segments: Indeed these [are] the mere edges of His ways, And how small a whisper we hear of Him! But the thunder of His power who can understand?"
